result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a section header shows an unresolved localization key instead of readable text.

issues.description: The section header below 'Fastest near you' displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Map the key to the correct localized string (e.g., 'Popular near you') and add a fallback to prevent raw keys from showing in the UI.
